step_by_step_reasoning: 1. Identified IoT end devices and LoRaWAN gateway connecting via 4G cellular network to AWS IoT Core for LoRaWAN. 2. Identified raw data ingestion path from IoT Core through Kinesis Data Firehose to Amazon S3 for long-term storage. 3. Identified event-driven processing path where IoT Core invokes AWS Lambda to transform data payloads. 4. Mapped dual downstream paths from Lambda: operational metrics sent via Kinesis Data Firehose to the Spark internal dashboard, and customer data routed via Amazon API Gateway to external customer applications. 5. Verified all node service values strictly match the valid vocabulary specification.

edges.notes: Device 1 transmits telemetry over wireless LoRaWAN network.
Device 2 transmits telemetry over wireless LoRaWAN network.
IoT Gateway transmits aggregated sensor data over 4G cellular to AWS IoT Core for LoRaWAN.
IoT Rules Engine routes raw data stream into Kinesis Data Firehose.
Kinesis Data Firehose persists raw payload into Amazon S3 bucket.
IoT Rules Engine invokes Lambda function for payload processing and transformation.
Lambda pushes processed operational telemetry to secondary Kinesis Data Firehose stream.
Kinesis Data Firehose feeds operational metrics into Spark internal support dashboard.
Lambda forwards customer-specific structured data to API Gateway.
API Gateway delivers data payloads into individual customer applications.
